comment: Retrieval benchmark for the memory semantic index. 'paraphrase' queries describe an entry's situation in words the entry does not use, so the embedding model is what has to find it; 'lexical' queries quote the body and should be found by the keyword arm alone, whatever the embedding model is. Authored 2026-09-30 from the entry bodies by reading them, not from titles.

queries.q: A migration ledger's rows do not add up to what actually landed in the tree, so diffing them reports entries as missing that are present.
A consolidated report page used to open the recorded browser run in a viewer, and now it only offers the bare file name.
I assumed what a file looked like instead of opening it, so my edits failed to match.
Where does a package put the machine-readable result that CI aggregates, and what else writes it?
Two persistent counters keep the materialised views coherent, because a boolean marker could not be cleared reliably.
What does a bare empty array mean in a chain, and what is the progress point called now?
A summary endpoint kept reporting work as outstanding for half a minute after the log said it had finished.
The notes grew until nobody could search them and every cross-reference rotted when the file was edited.
The browser build failed because a module both platforms share reached a Node-only module through an import chain.
Reading an environment variable in code that the browser also loads made every browser test time out.
A watchdog timer killed long-running servers thirty seconds after they started.
A table offered no choices at all because nothing ever populated its dropdown options.
The option list for a very large universe needs paging and a way to search it.
Changing the language from the menu bar does not survive the next login.
What happens when more than one realm answers the same configuration call?
A search and replace in the generator renamed a word that happened to appear inside a generated comment.
The object listing key has to keep the casing the service returns, or the snapshots break.
A test seed could not look up a role from another realm because the batches run in an unexpected order.
An assertion counting exactly one matching row failed on data another suite had left in the shared database.
The generated route table collapsed into a single key because the key was taken from the function name.
Why does the tool ship as its own binary rather than as a subcommand of the development CLI?
How must a handler file be named relative to the endpoint path it answers?
A budget meant to bound how long a run may take was counting the wrong thing entirely.
The scaffolding command never returned and left an empty directory behind.
The six reads sit behind a named port, and the namespace forwards to that port by name.
The chain is loaded lazily so that a browser link can survive it.
Which package owns the per-execution gate and the channel that records calls?
The argument parsing and entry detection moved into the framework package, but the log levels did not follow.
Parallel CI runs with heavier contention are deliberately left out of the retry workaround.
Which packages already fail their own test script, before my change?
A plain data file sitting inside a layer folder makes the loader log an error about a handler group.
The portal renames a node when two providers disagree, and keeps the first provider's answer.
